categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Electric Wind Power Group Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the design, research and development, manufacturing, and sales of wind power equipment. Its business segments include wind turbine manufacturing for onshore and offshore applications, wind farm development and investment, and after-sales services such as maintenance and digital asset management. The company also extends into wind resource development and integrated energy solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced wind turbine technologies including doubly-fed, half-direct-drive, and permanent magnet direct-drive systems. It has developed proprietary platforms such as the '卓刻' half-direct-drive and '卓越' doubly-fed platforms for onshore turbines, and the 'Poseidon' platform for offshore turbines. Manufacturing incorporates digital top-level design, intelligent production, and comprehensive testing facilities including a 40MW+ coastal test platform. The firm emphasizes modular design, carbon fiber blade technology, low-frequency 20Hz offshore turbines, and integrated floating offshore wind solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include wind farm developers and operators in China and overseas, particularly in Eurasia, Southeast Asia, and South Korea. The company serves large-scale onshore wind farms, offshore wind projects including deep-sea and floating wind farms, and provides services to existing wind farm operators. Its markets cover utility-scale renewable energy projects aligned with China's carbon neutrality goals and international green energy initiatives.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with extensive manufacturing bases across multiple provinces including Shanghai, Jiangsu, Shandong, Gansu, and others. It actively expands overseas markets with a focus on Europe, Southeast Asia, and South Korea. The company also maintains a European R&D center in Denmark to support international product development and certification.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Electric Wind Power operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the wind power supply chain. It manufactures complete wind turbine units and key components, procures upstream raw materials and parts from suppliers, and delivers integrated wind power solutions to end customers. Additionally, it engages in downstream wind farm development, investment, and operation, extending its presence along the value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation focusing on wind turbine large-scale development, digitalization, and intelligent manufacturing. R&D efforts target next-generation offshore turbines (20-25MW), floating wind technology, and grid-adaptive systems including low-frequency and virtual synchronous generator technologies. It invests in blade technology, drive chains, and digital platforms for lifecycle management. The firm also emphasizes expanding overseas R&D capabilities and collaborative innovation with universities and research institutes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of wind turbines and related components, provision of technical and maintenance services, and income from wind farm electricity generation and asset transfers. The company operates on a project-based sales model, securing orders via bidding and contracts, with revenues recognized upon delivery and service completion. It also earns investment returns from wind resource development and equity stakes in joint ventures.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai Electric Wind Power ranks among the top wind turbine manufacturers in China, holding approximately 4% market share in new installations as of 2024, placing it eighth nationally. Major competitors include Goldwind, Envision Energy, Mingyang Smart Energy, and Dongfang Electric. The company positions itself as a technology-driven leader with strengths in offshore wind and large-scale turbine platforms, aiming to enhance competitiveness through innovation and market expansion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 10.44 billion, a 3.2% increase year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB -784.8 million, showing a reduction in losses compared to the previous year. Total assets reached RMB 29.2 billion, growing nearly 13%. The company has experienced fluctuations due to market price declines and subsidy policy changes but is improving profitability through cost control and product upgrades. Cash flow from operations turned positive in 2024, reflecting improved order intake and collections.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering high-reliability, high-performance wind turbines tailored for diverse geographic and climatic conditions, including harsh environments like deserts and offshore deep waters. Its proprietary technology platforms enable large-scale, cost-effective turbines with advanced grid compatibility and digital lifecycle services. The integration of floating wind technology and comprehensive after-sales service, including specialized offshore maintenance vessels, differentiates it in the market. The firm leverages its industrial heritage and supply chain integration to offer competitive, innovative renewable energy solutions aligned with China's carbon neutrality goals.
